job.title: Intermediate Accountant | Genuine Pathway to Partner
job.description:
• Dee Why Location
  • Varied role / Great clients | Excellent Career Progression
  • $90-$120k + super (depending on experience)

Looking for more than just another accounting role? This could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

This Accounting Firm are looking for an enthusiastic and capable Intermediate Accountant to join its friendly, professional team in Dee Why.

With an established and diverse client base, a fantastic office environment and a genuine commitment to developing its people, this is an opportunity to build your technical accounting skills while developing meaningful relationships with clients.

The Opportunity

Working closely with experienced accountants and Partners, you'll be involved in a broad range of accounting and business advisory work across a diverse portfolio of clients.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing financial statements and tax returns for a variety of clients.
  • Assisting with month-end and year-end accounting processes.
  • Preparing BAS, GST and other compliance requirements.
  • Completing reconciliations and maintaining accurate financial records.
  • Communicating directly with clients and responding to their accounting needs.
  • Building trusted client relationships and becoming a valued point of contact.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers.

You'll ideally bring:

  • 2-5 years' experience in an accounting practice.
  • A degree in Accounting or a related discipline.
  • CA or CPA qualified, or currently studying towards qualification.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Confidence dealing directly with clients.
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • A genuine interest in developing your career long term.

Being based locally on the Northern Beaches would be a real advantage.

Why Join?

  • A genuinely great office environment in Dee Why.
  • A friendly, supportive and collaborative team.
  • Exposure to a broad and varied client portfolio.
  • Direct access to experienced accountants and Partners.
  • Opportunities to take on more responsibility as you develop.
  • Exceptional long-term career progression, with a genuine pathway to Partnership for the right person.

The Opportunity

This isn't simply a role to move into and stay in. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, develop strong client relationships and potentially become a future Partner.

If you're an ambitious Intermediate Accountant looking for a long-term home where your contribution and development are valued, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Client Service Officer - Wealth Management
job.description:
• Manly Location
  • $85K–$95K + Super
  • Growing Business / Great Team


Are you an experienced Client Services or Administration professional looking for your next opportunity within Wealth Management?

A growing boutique Wealth Management firm based in Manly is looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Client Service Officer to join its close-knit team.

Do you have experience in F365?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in financial services, wealth management, banking, superannuation or investment administration who enjoys working with clients, supporting a team and keeping things running smoothly.

The Role Working closely with the advisers and broader team, you'll manage a range of client administration and service activities, including:

  • Processing client transactions, account openings, contributions, withdrawals, rollovers and investment switches.
  • Preparing client applications and managing identification and KYC/AML requirements.
  • Maintaining accurate client records and processing client information updates.
  • Managing fee consent forms and ongoing fee arrangement renewals.
  • Preparing client review documentation, meeting packs and adviser follow-up actions.
  • Liaising with clients, platforms, super funds and product providers to resolve queries.
  • Monitoring outstanding requirements and ensuring requests are completed promptly.
  • Responding to client enquiries via phone and email.
  • Providing general office and administrative support.

About You You'll ideally bring:

  • Previous experience in client services or administration within financial services, banking, superannuation, wealth management or a related environment.
  • Experience with financial products, investment administration or account processing.
  • Exposure to platforms such as Netwealth, HUB24 or other investment platforms will be highly regarded.
  • A sound understanding of superannuation, pension or investment account administration will be advantageous.
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines.
  • A professional, friendly and client-focused approach.

Experience with Fin365 will be advantageous but is not essential.
What's on Offer?

  • $85K–$95K + Super, depending on experience.
  • Full-time, permanent opportunity.
  • Boutique and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunity to develop your career within financial services.
  • Convenient Manly location.

Apply Now If you have a background in financial services, banking, superannuation or client administration and are looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.
